module: Node "Load Project" (once_p_duration). Loads a flowgraph project by name (path relative to flowgraphEditor/, .flow.json extension optional) and runs it. Inputs: filepath, startNextFrame (starts on the next frame instead of immediately). When the parent project stops, the target project is stopped and deleted (data.destroyTargetOnStop, true by default).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Enables destroyTargetOnStop and clears the target.

postInit.desc: Restricts the file picker of the filepath pin to .flow.json files.

_executionStopped.desc: Stops the target (setRunning(false)) and removes it on the next frame via core_flowgraphManager.removeNextFrame if destroyTargetOnStop.

workOnce.desc: Resolves the path (tries the raw name, +.flow.json, flowgraphEditor/<name>.flow.json), loads the manager (core_flowgraphManager.loadManager) then starts it right away or on the next frame.
